subject: An appointment is available: $date at $time
body:
Dear $patient_name,

You are on the waiting list for a $appointment_type appointment, and one has just become available:

Date: $date
Time: $time
With: $practitioner

The offer is held for you until $expires. To take it, sign in to the Health Portal (Appointments > Waiting list) or call the Health Centre.

Best regards,
University Health Centre

$signature
